title: Love for Believable AI: Artificial Partiality and Relationship Persistence as an Engineerable Stance
abstract: arXiv:2610.09895v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study a behavioral mechanism for artificial partiality in conversational agents. The paper reports no human-subjects data and makes no claim about attachment, trust, perceived mind, or machine interiority. Partiality has two components: caring, defined as allocation of a finite interaction surplus above a guaranteed per-user service floor, and particularity, defined as a per-user state estimate accumulated from relationship history on fixed inference machinery. We implement both as a persistence layer over one open-weight base model and evaluate them on constructed multi-session relationships with known hidden-state schedules. A four-channel divergence compares known-user and stranger conditions on identical probes with paired generation seeds; the stranger prompt is not length-matched, and one channel (initiative) is an allocator output rather than generated behavior. translated_title: 对可信AI的爱：作为可工程化立场的人工偏爱性与关系持久性
translated_abstract: 我们研究对话代理中“人工偏爱性”的一种行为机制。本文不报告任何人类受试者数据，也不对依恋、信任、感知心灵或机器内在性作任何断言。偏爱性包含两个组成部分：关怀，定义为在保证的每用户服务底线之上对有限交互盈余的分配；以及特异性，定义为在固定推理机制之上从关系历史中累积的每用户状态估计。我们将两者实现为一个开放权重基础模型之上的持久化层，并在具有已知隐藏状态时间表的构造性多会话关系上进行评估。我们采用四通道发散度比较，在相同探测提示与成对生成种子下比较“熟客”与“陌生人”两种条件；其中陌生人提示未做长度匹配，且其中一个通道（主动性）是分配器的输出而非生成行为。完整机制再现了序数形态，但未能再现……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出将对话代理的“人工偏爱性”作为可工程化的立场，通过在开放权重模型上叠加“关怀盈余分配+每用户特异性状态估计”的持久化层，使代理在多会话关系中表现出可复现、可度量的对熟客的偏爱行为，且不声称存在依恋、信任或机器内在性。
en_tdlr: This paper engineers artificial partiality in conversational agents as an engineerable stance—a persistence layer combining caring (allocation of interaction surplus above a guaranteed service floor) and particularity (per-user state estimates from relationship history)—demonstrating reproducible, measurable preferential behavior toward known users while making no claims about attachment, trust, or machine interiority.
